oreshrines.effect.harvest.description: Crops, saplings and sugar cane grow about twice as fast.
oreshrines.effect.ward.description: No phantoms and no natural hostile mob spawns.
oreshrines.effect.hearth.description: Furnaces, smokers and blast furnaces smelt 50% faster.
oreshrines.effect.pasture.description: Baby animals grow up and breeding cooldowns end twice as fast.
oreshrines.effect.wisdom.description: Turns stored ore into XP for the nearest player in range.
oreshrines.effect.wisdom.rate: This pyramid pays out %s XP per second.
oreshrines.menu.no_pyramid: No pyramid: the shrine is inactive.
oreshrines.menu.no_pyramid.hint: Put a 3x3 of iron, gold or diamond blocks under the core.
oreshrines.menu.next_layer: Add another layer underneath for more range.
oreshrines.menu.help.1: Build a pyramid of iron, gold or diamond blocks under the core, like a beacon.
oreshrines.menu.help.2: Each layer adds range. Gold and diamond blocks reach further than iron.
oreshrines.menu.help.3: Right-click the core with an offering, or click it here, to pick the effect.
oreshrines.menu.help.4: Offerings are used up. Switching effects costs a new offering.
oreshrines.menu.click_to_offer: Click to offer one from your inventory
oreshrines.menu.feed_hint: Right-click the core with ore, or use a hopper.
oreshrines.message.full: The shrine can't hold any more.
